title: Vision-Language Model-Based Phase-OTDR Event Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.20841v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Phase-sensitive optical time-domain reflectometry (Phase-OTDR) enables distributed vibration sensing, but reliable event classification has traditionally relied on fully supervised models that require extensive annotated data. This study examines the adaptability of a Vision-Language Model (VLM) for Phase-OTDR event recognition through few-shot learning. Raw samples are converted into Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) dB-magnitude spectrogram mosaics, color-mapped and resized to RGB images, and processed by a Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) image encoder; few-shot adaptation optimizes only the Tip-Adapter-F cache keys, leaving both encoders unchanged. translated_title: 基于视觉-语言模型的相位敏感光时域反射（Phase-OTDR）事件分类
translated_abstract: 相位敏感光时域反射技术能够实现分布式振动传感，但可靠的事件分类传统上依赖于需要大量标注数据的全监督模型。本研究通过少样本学习考察了视觉-语言模型（VLM）在Phase-OTDR事件识别中的适应性。原始样本被转换为短时傅里叶变换（STFT）dB幅度频谱图拼图，经颜色映射并调整为RGB图像，随后由对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）图像编码器进行处理；少样本适配仅优化Tip-Adapter-F缓存键，两个编码器本身保持不变。在防泄漏协议下（每类512张图像的训练侧支持/验证池，每类固定的120张保留测试集，模型选择过程中不访问测试集，进行20次不同的支持集采样试验），所选配置（ViT-L-14 Vision Transformer...）（注：原文摘要到此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究提出利用CLIP视觉-语言模型结合Tip-Adapter-F少样本适配机制，将Phase-OTDR信号转为STFT频谱图像进行事件分类，在极少标注数据和防泄漏评测协议下实现了可靠的事件识别。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that a Vision-Language Model (CLIP) with Tip-Adapter-F few-shot adaptation on STFT spectrogram images enables reliable Phase-OTDR event classification with minimal annotated data under a leakage-controlled protocol.
